policy.compatibility: Every breaking change requires observed evidence, a replacement, an automated or documented migration, and consumer validation.
policy.nativeGraduation: Every public package and native adapter versions together at 2.0.0 after package, contract, migration, build, security, artifact, and two-release stability checks pass. External consumer and physical-device matrices remain transparent post-release qualification work and do not block the initial publication.
policy.nonGoal: Do not manufacture web breakage to justify the coordinated major release.

runtime.astro: Import UIPrimitives from @santi020k/lumen-astro/runtime and mount it once when an imported component declares the ui-primitives runtime.
runtime.elements: Call defineLumenElements once before rendering lumen-* elements.
runtime.react: Use the public React behavior hooks for behavior-heavy primitives.

changes.currentContract: UIPrimitives is exported from the Astro root barrel, so an otherwise static root import can pull the progressive-enhancement runtime into the emitted module graph.
changes.replacement: Import UIPrimitives as the default export from @santi020k/lumen-astro/runtime; keep static components as named root imports or direct component imports.
changes.migration: The Lumen v2 migrator splits UIPrimitives from mixed Astro imports and rewrites it to the runtime subpath. The transform must be idempotent and support dry-run output.

changes.currentContract: Astro and Elements still accept size=sm|default|lg as a pre-1.0 visual alias on Input and NativeSelect, colliding with the native numeric size attribute.
changes.replacement: Use visualSize in Astro and visual-size in Elements for visual sizing; reserve size for the native numeric attribute.
changes.migration: The Lumen v2 migrator rewrites only literal sm, default, and lg values on Lumen Input and NativeSelect usage. Dynamic values require a diagnostic and manual review.

changes.currentContract: Sonner is the public configurable toast viewport across Astro, React, and Elements, but its library-specific name obscures that distinct role and is easy to confuse with the Toast item contract.
changes.replacement: Use ToastViewport for explicit placement and stack configuration, Toast for individual notifications, and the framework-specific toast controller or provider for programmatic notification state. Sonner remains a deprecated 1.x compatibility alias before removal in v2.
changes.migration: The Lumen v2 migrator rewrites Sonner and SonnerProps imports to ToastViewport and ToastViewportProps while preserving local aliases, and renames lumen-sonner markup to lumen-toast-viewport without changing placement, maximum-count configuration, or children. Ambiguous imports require manual review.

changes.currentContract: The published LumenSurfacePadding and LumenSurfaceRadius enums expose only small, medium, and large roles, so product-owned cards cannot use the complete shared native surface scale without literal values.
changes.replacement: Use the additive xl padding role and xl, size2xl, or size3xl radius roles. Existing cases and the published Card, StatusBar, and lumenTheme call signatures remain available.
changes.migration: Exhaustive switches over LumenSurfacePadding or LumenSurfaceRadius must handle the new roles or add an @unknown default branch. Ordinary component calls require no migration.
swiftApiBreakages: enumelement LumenSurfacePadding.xl has been added as a new enum case
enumelement LumenSurfaceRadius.size2xl has been added as a new enum case
enumelement LumenSurfaceRadius.size3xl has been added as a new enum case
enumelement LumenSurfaceRadius.xl has been added as a new enum case

changes.currentContract: React Native date fields are exported from the package root and the datetime picker is a required peer, so consumers that never render a date field still inherit installation and native-linking requirements.
changes.replacement: Import LumenDateField, LumenDateRangeField, their props, and LumenDateRangeValue from @santi020k/lumen-react-native/datetime. Install @react-native-community/datetimepicker only in applications that use that subpath.
changes.migration: The Lumen v2 migrator splits date-field named imports from the React Native root into the datetime subpath while preserving aliases and type-only imports. An existing datetime-subpath import requires manual merging.

investigations.resolution: Retain the React package root as the complete client catalog and add a server-safe entrypoint for stateless primitives. The root reuses the same implementations, while repeatable Next.js measurements and clean packed-package consumers prove the additive boundary without requiring a breaking v2 root change.

Retain complete-catalog Elements registration and its typed component-set overload, while adding implementation-level Badge, Button, and Card entrypoints. The full catalog reuses the same constructors, and packed Astro consumer plus bundle evidence proves the additive granular path without requiring a breaking deprecation.
Retain the framework-neutral Core reexports from the umbrella root in Lumen 2. The API baseline and consumer audit found no observed problem that justifies a breaking removal.
